title: Password Manager Weak and Reused Credentials
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passwordmanager:audit
| stats sum(eval(strength="weak")) as weak, sum(eval(reused="true")) as reused, sum(eval(breached="true")) as breached
| eval total_issues=weak+reused+breached
description: Summarises the weak, reused, and breached passwords flagged by your password manager so you can tackle your worst security debt first.
value: Reused and breached passwords are the top cause of account takeovers; a running count turns a scary audit into a tidy to-do list.
implementation: Export your password manager's security-audit report to HEC; schedule weekly and drive the issue count toward zero.
visualization: Single-value panels for weak, reused, and breached credential counts.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many of your passwords are weak, reused, or leaked, so you can fix the most dangerous ones first.
